title: Nonlinear systems of PDEs admitting infinite-dimensional Lie algebras and their connection with Ricci flows. II: The two-dimensional space case
summary: The work is a natural continuation of that published in Stud Appl Math. 2024; 153:e12737. All possible two-components evolutions systems of (1+2)-dimensional second-order PDEs admitting an infinite-dimensional Lie algebra are constructed. It is shown that a natural generalisation of this Lie algebra to the higher-dimensional case does not lead to a more general result because the infinite-dimensional symmetry is broken.
